project.name: Senarai
project.hackathon: AI CAN DO IT Tencent Cloud Hackathon Indonesia 2026
project.blurb: Project history assembled, sourced, per access rights.

scopeDecision.decision: Ship the web app and a stdio MCP server. The MCP server was descoped in the morning and built the same evening.
scopeDecision.reason: The handbook requires WorkBuddy as the development platform, not as a runtime integration. That still holds, but a product an agent cannot call is a weaker product, and lib/ already held every guarantee, so the adapter cost one tool layer and one page.
consequences: mcp/server.ts exposes five tools over stdio; lib/mcp/tools.ts holds the handlers and imports no SDK.
Each handler calls lib/api/handlers.ts, the same functions app/api/* call, so no guarantee is reimplemented.
mcp/dist/server.mjs is a one-file bundle; the client config needs no tsconfig and no path aliases.
/integrations prints the client config with the current actor and project filled in.
No SSE transport and no shared thread memory; both limits are printed on /integrations.

phases.title: Scaffold, tokens, shell
phases.goal: Types frozen, design tokens live, shell rendering at three breakpoints.
phases.prompt: Create types/domain.ts with the full domain model, the data/ dataset (projects, roles, actors, sources, audit seed), and the application shell: sidebar 264/72/off-canvas, top bar with breadcrumb and locale toggle. No UI library, no state library.

phases.title: Access control and retrieval
phases.goal: canRead() before any search, and a static answer rendered from real data.
phases.prompt: Write canRead(snapshot, source) as a pure synchronous function over project, topic tag and sensitivity. Call it in search() before ranking, and again in toCitation(). Then render the three-section answer from the dataset.

phases.title: Composition, gaps, conflict, masking
phases.goal: One answer assembled from visible sources only, with the gap engine running in code.
phases.prompt: Compose chronology, open items and gaps in a fixed order. Detect gaps with three deterministic rules (no-cause, ownerless-blocked-item, silent-interval at 5 days). Resolve conflicts by newer version, then recency. Mask NIK and phone numbers before composition.

phases.title: Ask API, approval gate, scenarios 1 and 2
phases.goal: A question produces a thread; a gap produces a draft that sends only on approval.
phases.prompt: Add POST /api/ask, GET /api/threads/[threadId] and POST /api/approvals over the shared handlers. Apply a 600 ms floor. The approval sheet is the only modal: cancel writes nothing, confirm appends one audit entry.
verified: scenario 1: staff vs manager, same shape
scenario 2: gap → draft → approve → audit row
curl diff of forbidden vs non-existent is empty

phases.title: Scope mutation and the access matrix
phases.goal: A person can narrow their own scope, never widen it; the next answer reflects it.
phases.prompt: Add POST /api/scope and the /access matrix. Granting anything the role does not already carry returns 403. A revocation bumps the scope version and produces a new snapshot id, so two audit entries are comparable.
verified: scenario 3: 9 rows → 8 rows after revoking the customer tag

phases.title: Audit log and i18n
phases.goal: The record is a screen; the chrome is bilingual, the citations are not translated.
phases.prompt: Build /audit as a server-rendered table with caption and sticky header, scoped by role. Complete the ID/EN catalogue for chrome only. No hardcoded UI strings, no hex colours in components.
verified: decision column distinguishes answered / empty / empty-equivalent

phases.title: Tests, build, submission
phases.goal: Everything asserted that can be asserted; a production build that boots as a standalone server.
phases.prompt: Add a vitest suite over the guarantees, a scripted demo check against a running server, and the submission artifacts. Fix what the tests find.
verified: standalone server boots and answers on :3100

phases.title: MCP server and the integrations page
phases.goal: The same lib/ core reachable from an MCP client, with the guarantee proven across the transport boundary.
phases.prompt: Add a stdio MCP server whose five tools are thin wrappers over lib/api/handlers.ts. Bundle it with esbuild so the client needs no TypeScript loader. Add an /integrations page that prints the client config with the current actor and project, and assert that the tool returns the same substance as the HTTP path.
verified: npm run verify:mcp — 23 checks over a real stdio handshake
/integrations renders in both locales with the absolute bundle path

verificationLoop.pattern: assert in code → run → read the failure → fix the code, not the test
commands: npm run start & npm run verify:all
npm run mcp:build && npm run verify:mcp

findings.found: No chronology row cited a task card, so no single answer synthesised chat + document + task.
findings.fix: Closed tasks are history and now join the timeline; open tasks stay in section two. Staff answer: 9 rows across three source kinds.
findings.evidence: npm run verify → PASS T09 chat+doc+task synthesised

findings.found: POST /api/reset returned 404 in production, so a demo could not be reset on stage.
findings.fix: Env-gated with SENARAI_ALLOW_RESET=1 instead of a hard production block.

findings.found: deployment.md still described an MCP server that does not exist.
findings.fix: Rewritten for one process, standalone output, PM2 + Nginx.

findings.found: The MCP server was descoped, so a judge asking "how do I call this from an agent?" had no answer.
findings.fix: Built the stdio server over lib/api/handlers.ts and an /integrations page that prints a pasteable config.
findings.evidence: npm run verify:mcp — 23/23, including two roles differing and the canonical empty surviving the transport

findings.found: npm start answered 404 on every route, because next start cannot serve output: standalone.
findings.fix: scripts/start.mjs copies .next/static, public/ and data/ into the standalone folder, then runs server.js.
findings.evidence: /ask, /integrations and /api/ask all 200 from the production build

build.note: build:local only stubs Next's diagnostic trace writer, which a file-synced workspace denies. A normal VPS uses npm run build.

scenarioCheck.result: 34 checks against the web app, 23 over MCP

notes: This export records how the product was built and verified in WorkBuddy. The MCP server is a second transport over the same lib/ core, not a dependency of the web app: both run without the other.
Every prompt above is a condensed form of prompts/phase-*.md, which remain in the repository as the long form.
